strength.label: Shorter footprint with 22 kW AC
strength.text: The SWB pairs a 4,488 mm body and 11.31 m kerb-to-kerb turning circle with standard 22 kW AC capability, useful if your work involves tight sites and compatible depot charging.

tradeoff.label: Less cargo allowance than LWB

inheritedConflictContext.detail: PDF extraction from dimensions pages contains invisible obsolete underlying tables: 600/800 kg payload and old GVW/kerb/load volumes. Rendered current visible electric tables and p8 exact electric matrix establish 523/668 kg, 2230/2490 kg GVW, 1707/1822 kg kerb and 3.3/4.2 m³. Invisible leftovers are not competing live visual claims.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Visual rendering controls; exact p8 column anchors used.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: Generic p6/p7 drawings show heights 1864/1854 mm, body width 1860 mm and clearance 160/182 mm. Exact electric matrix p8 gives 1830 mm both, 1859 mm and 162 mm both.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Retain exact named electric-column 1830/1859/162; preserve drawings as generic illustrative alternatives. Do not silently replace exact electric values.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: Current brochure pp6–8 claims 170 km recovered in 27 min, while file p13 (printed16) says 30 min. Both use station at least 80 kW; no SOC interval.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Keep both indicative distance-recovery claims; no harmonised time/ranking or inferred 10–80%.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: Model page shortage footnote names 2025-built vehicles; April 2026 spec names 2026-built. Matrix shows smart digital mirror optional.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Optional/vehicle-specific availability, not guaranteed standard equipment.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: Public OEM data has price 61990/63990 with generic driveaway disclaimer, while visible header says POA. Secondary MY26 RedBook calls these excluding-government-charges price-when-new.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Keep raw OEM prices and secondary basis separately; fresh canonical manufacturer MLP/driveaway null.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: MY26 appears in official linked asset name; PDF footer says April 2026 without explicit model-year declaration. Dealer exact NEW ads are MY24/MY25.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Current family rows with MY hold; named MY26 brochure reference preserved, no VIN equivalence.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: June 16 announcement forecasts H2-2026 arrival; current manufacturer page markets both EV bodies. No later explicit arrival, exact NEW dealer ad, or accepted order confirmation found.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Announced/current-listed specifications, delivery and order acceptance unverified. Do not label future solely from June story or available-now solely from calendar.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: MY26 technical matrix labels electric tare 2344/2424 kg and unladen 2336/2416 kg. Tare is 8 kg greater than unladen; payload matches GVM minus unladen.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Preserve source labels literally; do not swap, invent kerb or silently correct.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: Standard 11 kW vehicle has V2L ticks. Factory 22 kW AC option explicitly says No V2L function.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Option conditional; no combined 22 kW+V2L selling claim.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: Launch generic equipment list names analogue 3.5-inch instrument cluster and underseat storage for all models. Exact electric matrix lists 7-inch digital cluster; underseat/mobile-office bench is option. Launch restricts bulkhead deletion to two-seat diesel, whereas matrix has broader generic option ticks.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Use exact electric 7-inch matrix; do not promise underseat storage/bulkhead deletion for exact BEV without verification.

inheritedConflictContext.detail: Generic LWB Carsales order template calls vehicle L3H2 Mid Roof and 13 m³ but gives 2778 mm height. Manufacturer exact E-Tech L3H2 is 2498 mm; 2778 applies diesel high roof L3H3.
inheritedConflictContext.resolution: Reject template dimension. No electric L3H3 configuration established.

inheritedConflictContext.issue: Current new/facelift page and configurator show 10-inch display, wireless phone connectivity, blind-spot detection and digital rear-view mirror, while current brochure index links a MY23 document with the older two-seat/8-inch equipment.
